accepted_evidence: Exact Open Library work record URL anchors identity/title; a mandatory exact-key Open Library search-index result supplies the earliest catalog publication year.
checks: exact-key query returns exactly one document with the same key and compatible title
claimed first publication year <= search-index earliest catalog year
exact_key_fallback: Removed: exact-key search is mandatory because direct work first_publish_date fields are frequently missing or polluted by late editions.
forbidden: whole raw Open Library objects in audit output
ambiguous or mismatched exact-key fallback results
limitation: Open Library provides an indexed first_publish_date ceiling, not certification of the exact historical first-publication year. Claimed years remain curated and independently sampled against authoritative bibliographic evidence.
resume_cache: When --live is combined with --rdf-cache and --evidence-cache, successfully parsed Gutenberg RDF, Open Library work JSON, and exact-key search JSON are atomically cached. Reruns reuse successes; malformed cached JSON/RDF is refetched live and replaced only after successful parsing.
retrieval: Three attempts with bounded timeout/backoff for Open Library work and exact-key JSON.
title_equivalence: Exact normalized title, or exact normalized primary-title equality before a colon, semicolon, or standalone or subtitle boundary; primary title must be at least 6 characters.
